meta.title: The Hai Van Pass! Is It The Greatest Coastal Road In The World? #vietnam #topgear #travelvlog
meta.description:
Day 10 of our Vietnam Explorer Tour with TruTravels! Today we will show you the beautiful Hai Van Pass and let you see whether or not you think it deserves it’s reputation of, “Greatest Coastal Road In The World!”

Welcome back everyone! We are on day 10 of our Vietnam Adventure and you better believe this was a good day! 

In this video we will be leaving the beautiful lantern town of Hoi An and heading to our next destination, the city of Huế! 

To get to Huế, we travelled in style… open top Jeeps along the breathtaking coastal road, the Hai Van Pass. Before embarking on this journey, we had to say our fond farewells to two of the most amazing people we have ever had the pleasure of meeting, Harry and Miles. Without getting too sentimental, we just want to express our love for these guys and thank them for giving us so many hilarious and touching memories in the short time we spent with them. We can’t wait for a reunion! 

After a teary farewell, we headed off with our group, stopping off at the beach for some amazing food and get some instagramable snaps!

We won’t spoil too much of this part of the video in the description… so get watching!

Finally, when we arrived, our guide took us to the water where we were given the opportunity to watch the sunset on a private boat. 

Thank you for watching everyone. Feel free to subscribe, hit the like button and if you want to see more of our Vietnam posts, check out our Vietnam playlist and ring the bell to stay notified for when day 11 drops!

Love,

Jack and Lindsey! X

#vietnam #fyp #travel #vlog #couple 


(For a more in depth look at where we visited and what you can expect from TruTravels head on over to our guide’s page. He is all about adventure and wanderlust. You will be in the best hands with @Dirtbiketourincambodiabyseyha 🇰🇭)

(For stunning 4K footage from the best in the business, head on over to our amazing friend Teja’s page! To quote Carly Simon… “Nobody does it better!” @storiesbydharma 🇮🇳)
